summary: Firefox is moving more font parsing and metrics work to Skrifa, improving how FreeType, Core Text, fontconfig, and downloaded webfonts are handled while simplifying font-table and variation support. Font caching and locking were tightened for safer sharing and better performance, particularly with changing fonts and web content. The changes also rename `font-stretch` to the standards-aligned `font-width` while keeping the old name as an alias, and adjust Linux hardware video-decoding behavior when dma-buf is unavailable.
